documentation.content:
The daily credit-only roller (FC-078) executed a roll, stranded a buy-to-close, or could not establish what one of its orders did. The operator must KNOW without reading logs.

Conditions:
- call_roll_completed: both legs done, quantities matched. Informational, but it is a two-leg live order pair on the book — look at it the same day.
- call_roll_naked_exposure: the BTC filled and every STO ladder rung failed. Shares UNCOVERED but long-only — NO naked short position. Worst case is the full BTC debit paid in cash with nothing sold against it, re-covered later through the entry path at entry-band premiums, adversely selected.
- call_roll_partial_naked_exposure: the STO filled FEWER contracts than the BTC closed. The difference is uncovered shares. Fields report both legs' qty and price explicitly; net_credit_on_replaced covers only the replaced quantity.
- call_roll_unknown_disposition / call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown: ACT ON THIS ONE. A cancel did not settle to a terminal status, so the bot does not know whether an order filled and deliberately stopped touching the position. An order may still be working. Check the Alpaca account directly before the next 15:30 cycle.
- call_roll_execution_error: an exception escaped execute_roll. It may have left a filled BTC behind — same weight as naked exposure.
- call_roll_order_refetch_failed: order reads were failing during a poll. Usually transient; if it precedes an unknown-disposition event it is the cause.

Triage:
1. gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.event_type=~"call_roll_(completed|naked_exposure|partial_naked_exposure|unknown_disposition|stc_disposition_unknown|execution_error)"' --limit=20 --freshness=1d
2. Completed roll: confirm both fills in options_wheel.trades_from_activities after the next 15-min ingest; NO residual open order on either leg's symbol. Assert new strike > old, new strike >= Alpaca avg_entry_price, fill credit = STO fill - BTC fill >= 0.
3. Uncovered shares (either flavour): confirm the next /scan -> /run re-covered. If the span gate holds it uncovered through earnings, that is correct by doctrine — record it, do not override.
4. Unknown disposition: reconcile open orders and positions by hand. Do not re-trigger /roll until the account matches expectations.

FC-120 quote diagnostics (informational, NOT paged): call_roll_btc_timeout_canceled - read quote_ask / cancel_quote_ask / quote_drift / limit_on_tick / quote_age_s / limit_minus_intrinsic on the event: a limit inside the true book (quote_drift > 0) is FC-120's case; a stale stamp (quote_age_s >> 60) is the feed. Every placed roll order also emits exactly one call_roll_leg_settled row (per leg, never alert-wired; fill_vs_limit, fill_latency_s, quote_reread_delta): gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-strategy" AND jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_leg_settled"' --freshness=7d

Stop the roller without a deploy: gcloud run services update options-wheel-strategy --update-env-vars ROLLER_ENABLED=false (never --set-env-vars; it wipes the whole env set).

NOTE: the filter deliberately does NOT constrain severity. Cloud Run captures the app's stderr as plain text with EMPTY severity, so a severity>=WARNING clause matches nothing (FC-030 fire drill, 2026-07-18). Payload shape is matched both ways.

Rate limit is 300s, not the 86400s used elsewhere: a second roll on the same day is a separate event the operator must see.

Plan: docs/plans/fc-078.md

conditions.displayName: Roll executed, failed, or disposition unknown

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-strategy" AND (jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_completed" OR textPayload:"call_roll_completed")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-strategy" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_partial_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_partial_naked_exposure" OR textPayload:"call_roll_naked_exposure" OR textPayload:"call_roll_partial_naked_exposure")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-strategy" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown" OR textPayload:"call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR textPayload:"call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-strategy" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_execution_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_execution_error" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR textPayload:"call_roll_execution_error" OR textPayload:"call_roll_order_refetch_failed"))
